description: Angular component for event filter panel in the Thingsboard UI, managing filter form controls, validation, and user interactions.

classes.name: EventFilterPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for event filter panel with form controls, validation, and user interaction logic.

methods.name: isSelector
methods.description: Checks if a key is one of the selector types ('msgDirectionType', 'status', 'entityName').

methods.name: isNumberFields
methods.description: Checks if a key corresponds to number-related filter fields.

methods.name: selectorValues
methods.description: Returns possible values for selector fields based on the key.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Collects form data, trims it, updates the result, and disposes of the overlay.

methods.name: showErrorMsgFields
methods.description: Determines whether to show error message fields based on form state.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Disposes of the overlay without saving changes.

methods.name: changeIsError
methods.description: Resets 'errorStr' control if 'isError' condition is cleared.
